question: What adult posterior-hypothalamic molecular regulatory state connects rs1421085 T>C to increased Irx3 expression, particularly in males?

upstream.claim: Engineered rs1421085 risk-allele mice show genotype-dependent Irx3 increase with a notable dose-dependent effect in male posterior hypothalamus.

downstream.claim: Increasing IRX3 in IRX3-positive posterior-hypothalamic neurons decreases neuronal excitability/activity and increases feeding/body weight; inhibiting those neurons phenocopies the behavioral direction.

missing_edge.to: Irx3 transcription increase in adult male posterior hypothalamus
missing_edge.missing: molecular mediator and native cell of regulatory action

hypotheses.name: ARID5B reuse
support: Exact rs1421085 ARID5B mechanism is causal in adipocyte progenitors.
CAUSAL-DNA GSE146692 screen detects Arid5b in 28.420% of Irx3-positive VPH cells.
against: DEL82 perturbation produced no detectable Irx3/Irx5 change in bulk young/adult hypothalamus.
No adult-PH exact-allele ARID5B occupancy measurement has been identified in reviewed primary studies.
hypotheses.next_test: Measure ARID5B occupancy at the intact rs1421085 element in T/T vs C/C adult PH cells, sex-stratified.

hypotheses.name: CUX1 exact-site/combinatorial role
support: Published exact-site assays show allele-dependent CUX1 P110/P200 binding preference.
CAUSAL-DNA GSE146692 screen detects Cux1 in 35.288% of Irx3-positive cells and 54.420% of Irx3/Arid5b double-positive cells.
against: Existing neuronal CUX1 model linked the locus to FTO/RPGRIP1L/AKTIP rather than genotype-associated IRX3/IRX5.
hypotheses.next_test: Measure CUX1 occupancy/state at the exact element in adult PH and perturb CUX1 while preserving the SNP-containing sequence.

hypotheses.name: Allele-dependent chromatin accessibility
support: Deletion-versus-point-substitution discordance is compatible with an intact-element state change.
hypotheses.next_test: Matched T/T vs C/C snATAC or targeted ATAC in cell-resolved adult PH, male and female.

hypotheses.name: Allele-dependent 3D enhancer-target contact
support: FTO obesity interval has published long-range IRX3/IRX5 interactions in brain/hypothalamic-neuron contexts.
Local CRM perturbation changes Irx3/Irx5 contact in an adipocyte differentiation state.
against: No adult-PH exact-T-vs-C enhancer-to-Irx3 contact measurement has been identified in reviewed primary studies.
hypotheses.next_test: Capture-C/4C or compatible cell-resolved contact assay using the rs1421085 element as bait in matched adult PH genotype/sex groups.

hypotheses.name: Indirect mediator
hypotheses.next_test: Raise priority only if local occupancy/accessibility/contact measurements fail to mediate the genotype-to-Irx3 effect.

hypotheses.name: Cell composition rather than per-cell transcription
support: Regional expression measurements cannot alone distinguish per-cell induction from composition/state shifts.
hypotheses.next_test: Exact-SNP single-cell or spatial expression with cell abundance and per-cell Irx3 modeled separately.

hypotheses.name: Sex/context interaction
support: Male posterior hypothalamus shows a notable genotype-dose Irx3 response that was not observed in females.
against: Coarse Arid5b/Irx3 and Cux1/Irx3 transcript co-detection is similar between pooled male and female GSE146692 cells.
hypotheses.next_test: Test allele-by-sex interaction at mediator layers, not only baseline sex differences.

hypotheses.name: Point-substitution-specific intact enhancer grammar
support: Exact T>C and 82-bp deletion yield discordant adult CNS observations.
rs1421085 has evidence for multiple allele-sensitive factor grammars.
hypotheses.next_test: Preserve the element and compare exact alleles while measuring occupancy, accessibility, contact and Irx3 in the same cells.

hypotheses.name: Temporal/developmental gating
support: Larger FTO obesity-interval deletion affects Irx3/Irx5 in embryonic/developmental hypothalamic contexts but not adult bulk hypothalamus.
Human hypothalamic precursor deletion effect is restricted to a POMC-expressing subgroup.
hypotheses.next_test: Include developmental/state markers in adult responding cells and compare with developmental locus states.

hypotheses.name: Multi-target enhancer grammar
support: Different cellular contexts link the FTO interval to IRX3/IRX5 versus FTO/RPGRIP1L target programs.
hypotheses.next_test: Measure Irx3, Irx5, Fto and Rpgrip1l together with contact/occupancy in the exact adult PH allele contrast.

demoted_candidates.name: LHX6 as broad direct adult-PH interpreter
demoted_candidates.reason: Only 11 of 1791 Irx3-positive GSE146692 cells co-detected Lhx6 transcript; developmental/rare-cell routes remain open.

demoted_candidates.name: NKX6-3 as broad direct adult-PH interpreter
demoted_candidates.reason: Only 5 of 1791 Irx3-positive GSE146692 cells co-detected Nkx6-3 transcript.

cell_of_action.note: Raw-count marker screens cannot reliably distinguish the native neuron-vs-glial regulatory cell of action; curated/spatial or exact-SNP cell-resolved data are required.

highest_information_next_test: Exact-allele, sex-stratified, cell-resolved adult posterior-hypothalamus experiment measuring Irx3 expression, local accessibility, ARID5B/CUX1 occupancy, and enhancer-to-Irx3 contact in matched biological material, followed by mediator perturbation/rescue.
